title: Google DeepMind Ships Three Physical AI Models For Whole Body Control, Dexterity And Multi Robot Collaboration
raw_text:
Google DeepMind has released Gemini Robotics 2, the intelligence layer for its next generation of robots. The release ships three models: a vision-language-action model for whole body humanoid control, Gemini Robotics ER 2 for embodied reasoning and task orchestration, and an on-device VLA that adapts to new robot bodies in hours. One checkpoint drives Apptronik Apollo 2 and a Franka Duo. Only ER 2 is publicly available.

The post Google DeepMind Ships Three Physical AI Models For Whole Body Control, Dexterity And Multi Robot Collaboration appeared first on MarkTechPost.

title_zh: 谷歌DeepMind发布三个物理AI模型，用于全身控制、灵巧操作和多机器人协作

title: GPT-Red: Automated Red Teaming via Self-Play at Scale
raw_text:
arXiv:2607.26115v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: We introduce \textbf{GPT-Red}, an automated red-teaming agent that is trained to discover novel prompt injection attacks against frontier LLMs. The goal of this model is to evaluate and improve the robustness of our production systems. To this end, we use it to adversarially train GPT-5.6, our most robust model to prompt injections to date. To create GPT-Red, we design a scalable self-play algorithm where the model is tasked with attacking a diverse population of simultaneously-trained defender agents. We train the model on realistic red-teaming environments using compute on the same scale as some of our largest RL post-training runs, making it the single-largest LLM safety training run ever documented. GPT-Red excels at red-teaming: it reliably breaks our past models up to GPT-5.5, it finds more successful attacks than human red-teamers, and it generalizes to held-out environments, defender models, and harnesses. title: GuidedRAG: Semantic Steering of Retrieval-Augmented Generation
raw_text:
arXiv:2607.26071v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: In this work, we propose GuidedRAG, a novel extension to traditional Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) that introduces a dedicated selection stage and semantic steering during retrieval. In contrast to current state-of-the-art RAG approaches, which depend on increasingly complex retrieval and knowledge structures, GuidedRAG constrains the knowledge base using semantics before retrieval, aligning the retrieval space with user intent while substantially reducing the search space. Our evaluation shows that GuidedRAG improves retrieval relevance by 14.0-15.8%, mitigates a 19.7-27.4% loss in retrieval precision, and reduces retrieval overhead by orders of magnitude. Moreover, relevant chunks are consistently retrieved earlier in the ranking process, while alignment with user intent improves by 31.8-36.8%. summary_zh: 本文提出GuidedRAG，一种对传统检索增强生成（RAG）的新扩展，在检索过程中引入专门的选择阶段和语义引导。与当前依赖日益复杂检索和知识结构的SOTA RAG方法不同，GuidedRAG通过约束知识选择，使生成更聚焦于相关语义。实验表明，GuidedRAG在保持性能的同时，降低了检索复杂性，提高了生成的相关性和准确性。

title: A Reference-Free Score for Detecting Silent Reasoning Failures in Large Language Models
raw_text:
arXiv:2607.26102v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Mathematical chain of thought (CoT) evaluation is commonly reduced to whether the final answer matches a reference. This conflates producing a correct conclusion with producing a valid derivation an invalid chain can accidentally reach the right answer, while a valid calculation can be followed by a transcription error. We call this mismatch the reasoning answer consistency gap. This framework paper introduces the Reasoning Answer Faithfulness Score (RAFS), a reference free, instance level diagnostic of whether an emitted mathematical trace is locally credible, supports its answer, and is stable under resampling and targeted counterfactual interventions. RAFS combines step validity, reasoning to answer entailment and counterfactual sensitivity, answer consensus, and conditional reasoning stability. It evaluates transcript level agreement, not a models private computation and not factual correctness outside the tested mathematical setti
reason_zh: 提出无参考分数检测LLM推理中的静默失败，解决数学CoT评估中最终答案与推导过程脱节的问题，具有重要方法论价值。
summary_zh: 数学思维链评估通常简化为最终答案是否与参考答案匹配，但这混淆了正确结论与有效推导：无效链可能偶然得到正确答案，而有效计算可能因转录错误而失败。该研究提出一种无参考分数，用于检测大型语言模型中的静默推理失败，即推理过程错误但最终答案正确的情况。该方法不依赖参考答案，通过分析推理链的内部一致性来识别潜在错误，为LLM推理评估提供了更可靠的指标。
title_zh: 一种用于检测大型语言模型静默推理失败的无参考分数

title: Try Again, Don't Look Back: Blind Resampling Outperforms Self-Repair in Small Code Models
raw_text:
arXiv:2607.26117v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Self-repair - returning a failed program to the model together with its test output and asking for a correction - is a standard component of code agents, and is almost always evaluated against a baseline that does not retry at all. We argue that this comparison confounds the value of the feedback with the value of the extra attempt. Using a placebo-controlled design on MBPP+ at three model scales (1.5B, 3B, 7B), we compare four matched-budget retry conditions: blind resampling, a content-free failure notice, genuine execution feedback, and feedback augmented with verbal self-reflection. Blind resampling is the strongest condition below 7B, and remains statistically tied with the best condition at 7B, while consuming 2.5-5.5x fewer tokens; conditioning on the model's own failed attempt costs 6.1 points at 1.5B (p=0.006), and the informational content of execution feedback adds nothing measurable over the placebo. reason_zh: 挑战代码智能体自我修复的常规做法，通过盲重采样对比实验证明额外尝试的价值，对代码生成评估有重要启示。
summary_zh: 自我修复是代码智能体的标准组件，通常将失败程序连同测试输出返回给模型并要求修正，但评估时几乎总是与完全不重试的基线比较。该研究认为这种比较混淆了反馈的价值与额外尝试的价值。通过安慰剂对照实验，研究者发现盲重采样（即不提供反馈的额外尝试）在小代码模型上优于自我修复，表明反馈可能并非关键，而额外尝试本身更有价值。这一发现对代码生成模型的评估和改进有重要影响。
title_zh: 再试一次，不要回头：盲重采样在小代码模型中优于自我修复

title: SARC-DQ: Runtime Data-Quality Gating for Agentic AI: Silent Evidence Defects, the Incompetence Shield, and Downstream-Only Remediation
raw_text:
arXiv:2607.26313v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Agentic systems act, so a defect in the evidence they retrieve becomes a wrong action with a currency cost. The most dangerous enterprise defects are metadata-borne: a stale price or a superseded record, perfectly well-formed in the payload and betrayed only by freshness, lineage, or provenance. Such a defect never enters the agent's context, and an agent cannot doubt data it cannot see. On a priced replenishment benchmark, a competent agent silently converts an injected metadata-borne defect into a costly action about 60% of the time, with zero data-quality flags and behavioral doubt markers at chance (AUC <= 0.50). Across four model tiers spanning roughly 15x in inference price, the rate stays flat: capability does not buy skepticism. A metadata-aware pre-action gate with downstream-only remediation recovers the loss fully on the signals its predicates cover and not at all on those they miss. summary_zh: 智能体系统会采取行动，因此其检索证据中的缺陷会转化为错误行动并带来成本。最危险的企业缺陷是元数据相关的：过时的价格或已取代的记录，在负载中格式良好，但仅通过新鲜度、血统或来源暴露。此类缺陷从不进入智能体的上下文，因此难以检测。本文提出SARC-DQ，一种运行时数据质量门控机制，用于在智能体行动前识别和修复此类缺陷，并采用仅下游修复策略。实验证明其有效性。
title_zh: SARC-DQ：智能体AI的运行时数据质量门控：静默证据缺陷、无能盾与仅下游修复

title: IDP AutoOpt: Agent-Driven Optimization of Document Processing Pipeline Configurations
raw_text:
arXiv:2607.26075v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: We present IDP AutoOpt, an autonomous LLM agent that discovers high-performing configurations for intelligent document processing (IDP) pipelines. Tuning IDP prompts, models, OCR settings, and schemas jointly currently costs domain specialists 20 to 80+ person-hours per document type and does not scale as enterprises add document classes. IDP AutoOpt runs a closed loop: it scores a configuration on a small labeled set, diagnoses field-level errors, generates targeted edits, and re-evaluates, guided by human-authored domain skills that encode production expertise. Across extraction, classification, and packet-splitting tasks deployed in healthcare, marketing-intelligence, and financial-services settings, IDP AutoOpt matches or exceeds human-expert accuracy at equal or lower cost (on an extraction benchmark, 90.2% vs 81.6% at 4.6 x lower per-page cost), cutting configuration time from weeks to under two hours. title: 广电总局出台《微短剧发展管理办法》并将于 9 月 1 日起施行：AI 生成内容须添加标识，禁用诱导沉迷算法
raw_text:
IT之家 7 月 31 日消息，国家广播电视总局今日发布了《微短剧发展管理办法》（IT之家以下简称“办法”），并将于 2026 年 9 月 1 日起施行。作为我国首部针对微短剧的专门部门规章，该办法构建了从创作备案、内容审核到播出监管的全链条制度框架。

《办法》明确，微短剧是指单集时长少于 20 分钟、主题主线明确、故事情节连续完整、人物角色突出的剧集。播出渠道涵盖互联网站、应用程序、广播电视频道、互联网电视、IPTV、有线电视等，接收终端包括电视机、手机、平板、电脑、公共电子屏及车载设备等。

微短剧按投资额度和题材分为三类。一类微短剧指投资额度较大或主要剧情涉及政治、军事、外交、国家安全、统战、民族、宗教、司法、公安等特殊题材的微短剧；二类微短剧指投资额度相对不大且为一般题材的微短剧；三类微短剧指投资额度较低且为一般题材的微短剧。

在审核许可方面，一类和二类微短剧拍摄制作完成后，播出前须向省级以上广播电视主管部门申请内容审核和发行许可。审核通过的一类微短剧由省级以上广电主管部门颁发《微短剧发行许可证》；二类微短剧由省级广电主管部门颁发批准文件。三类微短剧则由符合条件的播出单位履行内容管理职责，进行播前审核并标注节目编号。未取得许可证、批准文件或未经审核标注编号的微短剧，不得播出和参加评奖评优。

使用人工智能技术生成、制作的微短剧，须在每集明显位置添加提示标识。微短剧播出单位不得使用诱导用户沉迷、过度消费等的算法模型。《办法》同时要求微短剧播出单位建立并落实总编辑内容负责制。

《办法》明确“鼓励、支持广大群众参与微短剧创作”，将微短剧定位为“互联网条件下新大众文艺”。同时鼓励微短剧赋能千行百业，支持优秀微短剧境内外同步播出。据北京日报给出的行业数据，当前微短剧市场规模已突破千亿元，用户规模约 7 亿。

相关阅读：

  • 《中国广电在电视端和手机端上线微短剧专区》

summary_zh: 现有AI治理框架如欧盟AI法案和NIST AI RMF，虽然涉及安全、透明和问责，但未对宏观社会经济稳定性实施量化约束。因此，AI系统可能满足监管要求，却加剧劳动力替代、不平等加剧和经济活力下降。本文提出人类效用因子，一个可计算的福利指标，将AI治理重新定义为约束优化问题，旨在平衡技术进步与社会福祉，为政策制定者提供量化决策工具。

title: Quoting Bruce Schneier
raw_text:
The writing assignments I give my students are gym tasks, not work tasks. I ask them to write policy memos not because the world needs more policy memos. I assign them because the very act of writing, which includes thinking and outlining and drafting and editing, making and criticizing and revising arguments, will help develop the critical thinking skills they will need in their future careers. And without this constant mental exercise, those skills will atrophy. Employers are already noticing.

— Bruce Schneier, Should You Use AI for a Task? Here’s a Simple Way to Decide

Tags:
reason_zh: Bruce Schneier 提出用“健身任务 vs 工作任务”区分是否该用AI，视角独特，能帮你建立更清晰的AI使用决策框架。
summary_zh: Bruce Schneier 在博客中提出一个简单方法来判断是否应该使用AI完成任务：区分“健身任务”和“工作任务”。健身任务是指那些为了锻炼技能而做的练习，比如学生写政策备忘录，目的不是产出，而是通过写作过程（思考、提纲、起草、编辑）来学习。工作任务则是真正需要产出结果的任务。他认为，如果任务是健身任务，就不应该用AI代劳，否则会失去锻炼机会；如果是工作任务，则可以考虑使用AI提高效率。这个框架帮助人们更理性地决定何时依赖AI。

title: SimpleWikiSearch: A Clean Offline Wikipedia Environment for Agentic Search
raw_text:

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agentic search systems are often evaluated as if the underlying LLM were the only component that matters, yet their measured performance also depends on the surrounding search environment: the Wikipedia snapshot, preprocessing pipeline, chunking policy, retrieval backend, tool schema, observation format, and answer submission rule. The environment starts from a full English Wikipedia dump, cleans and chunks the corpus, builds keyword and dense retrieval indexes, and exposes a minimal tool interface consisting of \texttt{search}, \texttt{open\_url}, and \texttt{submit\_answer}. We report baseline results on six QA datasets using open-source LLMs and pr

summary_zh: 基于LLM的智能体搜索系统评估往往只关注底层LLM，但实际性能还取决于周围搜索环境，如Wikipedia快照、预处理流程、分块策略、检索后端、工具模式、观察格式和答案生成。本文介绍SimpleWikiSearch，一个干净的离线Wikipedia环境，旨在标准化这些环境因素，使智能体搜索评估更公平和可复现。该环境为研究人员提供了统一的测试平台。

title: The Age of AI Agents Demands A New Scientific Paradigm To Sustain Trustworthy Science
raw_text:
arXiv:2607.26064v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: AI systems are becoming autonomous research agents that generate hypotheses, design experiments, and produce discoveries at scales beyond human oversight. As seen by increased submissions to ML venues, the verification gap between scientific output and our ability to check it is already widening, and autonomous agents make it worse by magnitudes given human-agent asymmetry. We argue that science must evolve its verification infrastructure, as it has before with peer review. However, while historical adaptations assumed human contributors who could be questioned and sanctioned, AI agents break this assumption. We propose criteria for an adapted verification infrastructure that emphasizes observable-by-default workflows, scalable verification, and clear attribution. We argue that without adaptation, ML and any scientific domain using agents face dangerous failures: experimental results that no person can verify, optimization for metrics
reason_zh: 提出AI智能体时代科学验证的新范式，直击自主研究带来的验证鸿沟，对科研诚信和AI治理有深远影响。
summary_zh: 随着AI系统成为自主研究智能体，能够生成假设、设计实验并以超出人类监督的规模产生发现，科学验证面临前所未有的挑战。论文指出，机器学习会议投稿量激增已显示科学产出与验证能力之间的差距正在扩大，而自主智能体将这一差距放大数个数量级。作者呼吁建立新的科学范式，以维持可信的科学体系，强调需要开发新的验证方法和治理框架来应对AI驱动的科学发现。
title_zh: AI智能体时代需要新科学范式以维持可信科学

title: cline/cline cli-v3.0.48
raw_text:
- `cline history` now opens inside the existing TUI, with resume and delete actions, instead of rendering a second view in the same process
- Connector threads (Slack, Discord, Telegram, Linear, Google Chat, WhatsApp) now recover when the session they were bound to is gone — the stale binding is dropped and the turn replays against a new session, instead of failing with "session not found" until `threads.json` is edited by hand
- `cline --help` now reports the real default `--config` and `--data-dir` paths
- The per-server `timeout` in `cline_mcp_settings.json` is now honored for `initialize`, `tools/list`, and `tools/call`, so slow MCP servers no longer fail against a hardcoded 5s limit (from SDK v0.0.67)
- Reasoning controls are now routed from the models.dev catalog across providers, with clamped budgets and correct per-provider encoding (from SDK v0.0.67)
- OpenRouter now defaults to `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5` (from SDK v0.0.67)
- Fixed the China and international endpoint toggle
reason_zh: Cline CLI更新改进历史查看和连接器恢复，对开发者实用。

title: AI Security Priorities: A Field-Wide Agenda
raw_text:
arXiv:2607.26069v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: As AI systems are rapidly integrated into critical economic, governmental, and national security functions, the gap between AI adoption and AI security readiness continues to widen. This paper presents a prioritized agenda for advancing AI security, informed by structured interviews with leaders across industry, government, and civil society, and refined through a multi-sector expert workshop. Participants identified and ranked the highest-importance and most cost-effective areas where progress could strengthen AI security - from protecting frontier AI systems and their underlying infrastructure to improving cybersecurity practices as AI reshapes the threat landscape. The resulting priorities are organized across four themes: establishing strategic foundations and policy frameworks; advancing public-private coordination and institutional infrastructure; advancing technical security engineering and assurance; and governing agentic AI un
reason_zh: 基于行业、政府、公民社会领袖访谈，提出AI安全优先议程，对AI安全研究和政策制定有指导意义。
summary_zh: 随着AI系统快速融入关键经济、政府和国家安全功能，AI采用与AI安全准备之间的差距持续扩大。本文基于对行业、政府和公民社会领袖的结构化访谈，提出推进AI安全的优先议程。议程涵盖技术、政策和组织层面的关键行动，旨在缩小安全差距，确保AI系统的可靠性和安全性。该议程为AI安全领域的研究和实践提供了路线图。
title_zh: AI安全优先事项：领域议程
